package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"time"
)

func main() {
	fmt.Println("=== 1. Switch Standar dengan Multi-kondisi ===")
	statusCode := 500
	switch statusCode {
	case 200, 201:
		fmt.Println("HTTP Request Sukses!")
	case 400, 401, 403, 404:
		fmt.Println("HTTP Client Error!")
	case 500, 502, 503:
		fmt.Println("HTTP Server Error - Tim engineer sedang menangani!")
	default:
		fmt.Println("Status HTTP tidak dikenali.")
	}

	fmt.Println("\n=== 2. Switch Tanpa Kondisi (Pengganti If-Else Panjang) ===")
	today := time.Now().Weekday()
	switch {
	case today == time.Saturday || today == time.Sunday:
		fmt.Println("Ini akhir pekan, kurangi deployment ke Production!")
	case today == time.Friday:
		fmt.Println("Hari Jumat! Pastikan tidak ada deploy jam 5 sore.")
	default:
		fmt.Println("Hari kerja normal. Silakan push fitur.")
	}
}
